definitions.name: Local Field Cell
definitions.definition: A localized field unit containing compressive and repulsive state information.

definitions.name: Compressive Field M
definitions.definition: A three-component inward compressive vector field (Mx, My, Mz).

definitions.name: Repulsive Field A
definitions.definition: A three-component outward repulsive vector field (Ax, Ay, Az).

definitions.name: Local Manifold State Psi
definitions.definition: The six-component local state (Mx, My, Mz, Ax, Ay, Az).

definitions.name: Propagation Vector D
definitions.definition: The local propagation vector governed by the negative compressive-field gradient.

definitions.name: Phase Lock
definitions.definition: The state approached as M - A tends to zero.

definitions.name: Boundary Jam
definitions.definition: A state reached when local tension capacity and limiting external resistance occur together.

definitions.name: Harmonic Packet
definitions.definition: Preserved structural information ejected after phase lock.

definitions.name: Clean Cell Pool
definitions.definition: Destination pool for preserved structural packets; reinsertion rules remain undefined.

definitions.name: 64-Cell Frame
definitions.definition: An 8 x 8 spatial frame containing 64 coordinates.
